note: On-screen captions of AynaLoop, also written to web/public/landing/ayna-loop.vtt by scripts/render.mjs. Frames at 30 fps; {placeholders} come from the featured run. 'single' replaces a cue when only one version passed SAM 3.1, so Muse Spark had nothing to choose between.

cues.text: Finds every object on your photo
Writes the edit for this exact photo
Develops {versions} versions of the after photo
Checks every object in every version
Picks the version that follows the request

single.text: Only version {chosen} kept every object, so it goes on

cues.text: It is the plan you approve before a robot touches anything
Orders the moves and gives each one to a robot that can do it
The robots move SAM 3D bodies in a physics twin of the table
Every object is measured against the after photo
